description: This file is a shell script for testing various aspects of git's 'for-each-ref' command, including ref listing, filtering, sorting, formatting, and special format options. It contains multiple test cases using a test framework that checks git's behavior in different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual command output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after test completes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all tests.
